spec.generation_notes: The object is modeled as a rectangular prism. The top view defines the cross-section in the XY plane (width x depth), including the central hole. The right view defines the side profile (depth x height), showing the slots. The front view confirms the overall height and width. The slots are interpreted as cuts through the width (X-axis) to hold cables, while the hole is a cut through the depth (Y-axis) for mounting.
